pairs.summary: THRB and ZNF816 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 11 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; ...). Median lift 1.41x, typical spacing ~60 bp between sites. In 11 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. It is enriched in most profiles, so it may reflect general sequence composition of accessible DNA rather than context-specific cooperation. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
